title: Air Force going-public plan called off

tellings.quote: he said 2009 to 2010, he was part of an air force going public plan that was called off by a twostar general.

plain: Between 2009 and 2010, a man named Ed was part of an Air Force plan to tell the public about these mysteries, and a two-star general shut the plan down. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this, repeating what Ed told him. If true, the government came close to going public years before anyone heard about it.
